fullPassage: If astronauts travel to Mars in the near future, the journey will probably take years. Therefore, providing the astronauts with enough to eat will be a major challenge. Scientists are now looking for ways to allow astronauts to extend their food supply by growing crops. Seeds take up less storage space than packaged meals, and astronauts can plant them once they reach Mars. NASA is already conducting experiments to find out what might grow on Mars. The soil on Mars is made up mostly of crushed rocks, so it has few or no nutrients. In a test, NASA planted lettuce in crushed volcanic rock from Hawaii, which also contains few nutrients. The lettuce took a long time to grow, but it tasted normal. Because this test was a success, NASA now plans to find out how long other vegetables would take to grow on Mars.

questions.passage: If astronauts travel to Mars in the near future, the journey will probably take years. Therefore, providing the astronauts with enough to eat will be a (A)[minor / major] challenge. Scientists are now looking for ways to allow astronauts to (B)[reduce / extend] their food supply by growing crops. Seeds take up (C)[less / more] storage space than packaged meals, and astronauts can plant them once they reach Mars. NASA is already conducting experiments to find out what might grow on Mars. The soil on Mars is made up mostly of crushed rocks, so it has few or no nutrients. In a test, NASA planted lettuce in crushed volcanic rock from Hawaii, which also contains few nutrients. The lettuce took a long time to grow, but it tasted normal. Because this test was a success, NASA now plans to find out how long other vegetables would take to grow on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) major=주요한 / minor=사소한 (B) extend=늘리다 / reduce=줄이다 (C) less=더 적은 / more=더 많은
det.analysis:
① major — extend — less: 먹거리 공급은 '주요한(major)' 과제이고, 작물을 길러 식량을 '늘리며(extend)', 씨앗은 '더 적은(less)' 공간을 차지한다 ←정답
② minor: 사소한 과제가 아니라 주요한 과제
③ reduce: 식량을 줄이는 게 아니라 늘림
④ minor/reduce: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 화성 식량 확보는 major 과제, 작물로 식량을 extend, 씨앗은 less 공간

questions.passage: If astronauts travel to Mars in the (A)[distant / near] future, the journey will probably take years. Therefore, providing the astronauts with enough to eat will be a major challenge. Scientists are now looking for ways to allow astronauts to extend their food supply by growing crops. Seeds take up less storage space than packaged meals, and astronauts can plant them once they reach Mars. NASA is already conducting experiments to find out what might grow on Mars. The soil on Mars is made up mostly of crushed rocks, so it has few or no nutrients. In a test, NASA planted lettuce in crushed volcanic rock from Hawaii, which also contains few nutrients. The lettuce took a long time to grow, but it tasted (B)[normal / strange]. Because this test was a (C)[failure / success], NASA now plans to find out how long other vegetables would take to grow on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) near=가까운 / distant=먼 (B) normal=정상의 / strange=이상한 (C) success=성공 / failure=실패
det.analysis:
① distant: 문맥은 '가까운(near)' 미래
② strange/failure: 상추 맛은 '정상(normal)'이고 실험은 '성공(success)'
③ near — normal — success: 가까운 미래에 화성 여행, 상추 맛은 정상, 실험은 성공 ←정답
④ distant/strange/failure: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: near future(가까운 미래), tasted normal(맛은 정상), was a success(성공)

questions.passage: If astronauts travel to Mars in the near future, the journey will probably take years. Seeds take up (B)[more / less] storage space than packaged meals, and astronauts can plant them once they reach Mars. NASA is already conducting experiments to find out what might grow on Mars. The soil on Mars is made up mostly of crushed rocks, so it has few or no nutrients. In a test, NASA planted lettuce in crushed volcanic rock from Hawaii, which also contains few nutrients. The lettuce took a long time to grow, but it tasted normal. Because this test was a (C)[success / failure], NASA now plans to find out how long other vegetables would take to grow on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) major=주요한 / minor=사소한 (B) less=더 적은 / more=더 많은 (C) success=성공 / failure=실패
det.analysis:
① minor: 먹거리 확보는 '주요한(major)' 과제
② major — less — success: 먹거리 확보는 주요한 과제, 씨앗은 '더 적은(less)' 공간을 차지, 실험은 '성공(success)' ←정답
③ more/failure: 더 많은 공간·실패는 문맥과 반대
④ minor/more/failure: 모두 반대
det.tip: major challenge(주요 과제), less space(더 적은 공간), a success(성공)

questions.passage: If astronauts travel to Mars in the near future, the journey will probably take years. Therefore, providing the astronauts with enough to eat will be a major ①<u>challenge</u>. Scientists are now looking for ways to allow astronauts to extend their food ②<u>supply</u> by growing crops. Seeds take up less storage space than packaged meals, and astronauts can plant them once they reach Mars. NASA is already conducting experiments to find out what might grow on Mars. The soil on Mars is made up mostly of crushed rocks, so it has ③<u>many</u> or no nutrients. In a test, NASA planted lettuce in crushed volcanic rock from Hawaii, which also contains few nutrients. The lettuce took a long time to grow, but it tasted ④<u>normal</u>. Because this test was a success, NASA now plans to find out how long other vegetables would take to grow on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① challenge=과제 ② supply=공급 ③ few→many (부적절) ④ normal=정상의
det.analysis:
① challenge: 먹거리 제공은 주요 '과제' — 적절
② supply: 식량 '공급'을 늘림 — 적절
③ many: 으스러진 암석 토양은 영양분이 '거의 없다'. many(많은)는 반대 → few가 원문 ←정답
④ normal: 상추 맛이 '정상' — 적절
det.tip: 화성 토양은 few(거의 없는) 영양분. many는 정반대

questions.passage: If astronauts travel to Mars in the near future, the ①<u>journey</u> will probably take years. Therefore, providing the astronauts with enough to eat will be a major challenge. Scientists are now looking for ways to allow astronauts to ②<u>reduce</u> their food supply by growing crops. Seeds take up less storage space than packaged meals, and astronauts can plant them once they reach Mars. NASA is already ③<u>conducting</u> experiments to find out what might grow on Mars. The soil on Mars is made up mostly of crushed rocks, so it has few or no nutrients. In a test, NASA planted lettuce in crushed volcanic rock from Hawaii, which also contains few nutrients. The lettuce took a long time to grow, but it tasted normal. Because this test was a success, NASA now plans to find out how long other ④<u>vegetables</u> would take to grow on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① journey=여정 ② extend→reduce (부적절) ③ conducting=수행하는 ④ vegetables=채소
det.analysis:
① journey: 화성으로의 '여정'은 수년이 걸림 — 적절
② reduce: 작물을 길러 식량 공급을 '줄인다'? 늘리는 것이므로 extend가 원문 ←정답
③ conducting: NASA가 실험을 '수행하는' — 적절
④ vegetables: 다른 '채소'가 얼마나 걸릴지 — 적절
det.tip: 작물을 기르면 식량을 extend(늘림). reduce(줄임)는 반대

Scientists are now looking for ways to allow astronauts to extend their food supply by growing crops. The ③<u>soil</u> on Mars is made up mostly of crushed rocks, so it has few or no nutrients. In a test, NASA planted lettuce in crushed volcanic rock from Hawaii, which also contains few nutrients. The lettuce took a long time to grow, but it tasted normal. Because this test was a ④<u>failure</u>, NASA now plans to find out how long other vegetables would take to grow on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① eat=먹다 ② storage=저장 ③ soil=토양 ④ success→failure (부적절)
det.analysis:
① eat: 먹을 것을 충분히 제공 — 적절
② storage: 씨앗은 '저장' 공간을 덜 차지 — 적절
③ soil: 화성의 '토양' — 적절
④ failure: 실험이 '실패'였기 때문에 다른 채소 재배를 계획? 성공이므로 success가 원문 ←정답
det.tip: 실험이 success(성공)라서 후속 계획을 세움. failure(실패)면 계획할 이유 없음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 conducting과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: conduct=수행하다 / cancel=취소하다 / delay=지연하다 / carry out=실행하다 / avoid=피하다

det.tip: conducting experiments = 실험을 수행하다/실행하다(carry out)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 success와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: success=성공 / failure=실패 / achievement=성취 / victory=승리 / distance=거리

③ victory: 승리 — success와 유사
④ distance: 거리 — 의미축이 전혀 다름
det.tip: success(성공)의 반대는 failure(실패). achievement·victory는 유의어

questions.passage: If astronauts travel to Mars in the near future, the journey will probably take years. Therefore, providing the astronauts with enough to eat will be a major challenge. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 long과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: long=긴 / lengthy=장황한, 긴 / short=짧은 / endless=끝없는 / quick=빠른
det.analysis:
① lengthy: 긴 — long의 동의어
② short: 짧은 — long의 반의어 ←정답
③ endless: 끝없는 — long과 유사
④ quick: 빠른 — 속도 개념으로 의미축이 다름
det.tip: a long time(긴 시간)의 반대는 short(짧은). lengthy·endless는 유의어

questions.passage:
(A) Seeds take up less storage <u>space</u> than packaged meals, so they are easy to carry on a long mission. Astronauts can keep many seeds in a small container.

(B) When the astronauts looked out of the window, they saw the deep, dark <u>space</u> filled with countless stars. The silence of the universe amazed them.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 space의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: space: (A) 공간, 자리 (B) 우주
det.analysis:
① (A) 공간, 자리 (B) 우주: storage space=저장 공간, dark space filled with stars=별로 가득 찬 우주 ←정답
② (A) 우주 (B) 공간: 저장 우주? 부적절
③ (A) 공간 (B) 여백: 별이 가득한 여백? 부적절
④ (A) 우주 (B) 여백: 모두 부적절
det.tip: space의 다의어: 저장 공간(자리) vs 우주. 문맥으로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a substance in food that living things need in order to grow and stay healthy"

det.korean: flavor=맛 / recipe=조리법 / nutrient=영양소 / harvest=수확
det.analysis:
① flavor: 맛 — 정의와 무관
② recipe: 조리법 — 정의와 무관
③ nutrient: 영양소 — 생물이 자라고 건강을 유지하는 데 필요한 물질 ←정답
④ harvest: 수확 — 정의와 무관
det.tip: need in order to grow and stay healthy = 성장·건강에 필요한 물질 → nutrient(영양소)

questions.passage: NASA is already __________ (conduct) experiments to find out what might grow on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: conduct(수행하다) → conducting. 'is already ___'는 be동사 뒤이므로 현재진행형(be + V-ing)이 필요
det.analysis: conduct를 현재진행형 conducting으로 변환. 'NASA is already conducting' = 'NASA는 이미 실험을 수행하고 있다' — be동사(is) 뒤 진행형이므로 동사원형에 -ing
det.tip: be동사(is) + 이미(already) → 진행 중 → conduct + ing = conducting

questions.passage: In a test, NASA planted lettuce in __________ (crush) volcanic rock from Hawaii, which also contains few nutrients.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: crush(으스러뜨리다) → crushed. 뒤의 명사 rock을 꾸미는 과거분사(~된)로 변환
det.analysis: crush를 과거분사 crushed로 변환. 'crushed volcanic rock' = '으스러뜨려진(잘게 부순) 화산암' — 명사 rock을 앞에서 꾸미는 과거분사(수동: 부서진 상태)가 필요
det.tip: 명사(rock)를 꾸미며 '~된' 뜻 → 과거분사 → crush + ed = crushed

questions.passage: If astronauts travel to Mars in the near future, the journey will probably take years. Therefore, providing the astronauts with enough to eat will be a major challenge. Scientists are now looking for ways to allow astronauts to extend their food supply by __________. Seeds take up less storage space than packaged meals, and astronauts can plant them once they reach Mars. NASA is already conducting experiments to find out what might grow on Mars. The soil on Mars is made up mostly of crushed rocks, so it has few or no nutrients. In a test, NASA planted lettuce in crushed volcanic rock from Hawaii, which also contains few nutrients. The lettuce took a long time to grow, but it tasted normal. Because this test was a success, NASA now plans to find out how long other vegetables would take to grow on Mars.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: storing meals=식사 저장하기 / crushing rocks=암석 부수기 / growing crops=작물 재배 / packing seeds=씨앗 포장하기
det.analysis:
① storing meals: 식사를 저장해 식량을 늘림? 이미 저장 식량은 부피가 큼
② crushing rocks: 암석을 부숴 식량을 늘림? 부적절
③ growing crops: 작물을 재배해 식량 공급을 늘림 ←정답
④ packing seeds: 씨앗을 포장? 식량을 늘리는 방법이 아님
det.tip: extend their food supply by _____ → 식량을 늘리는 방법 = growing crops(작물 재배)
